{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Edge where
  | mk (u v : Nat)

deriving instance BEq for Edge

def valid_n (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  n ≤ 10

def valid_edges (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ edges, e.1 < n ∧ e.2 < n

def valid_input (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Prop :=
  valid_n n ∧ valid_edges n edges

def dedup_edges (edges : List Edge) : List Edge :=
  edges.filter (fun e => !edges.takeWhile (fun f => f ≠ e).contains e)

def indegree (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (v : Nat) : Nat :=
  (dedup_edges edges).filter (fun e => e.2 = v).length

def out_edges (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (dedup_edges edges).filter (fun e => e.1 = u).map (fun e => e.2)

def kahn_order (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : List Nat :=
  let deduped := dedup_edges edges
  let in_deg : List Nat := List.range n |>.map (fun v => indegree n deduped v)
  let rec step (remaining : List Nat) (in_deg : List Nat) (acc : List Nat) : List Nat :=
    match remaining with
    | [] => acc
    | _ =>
      let zero_idx := in_deg.findIndex (fun d => d = 0)
      match zero_idx with
      | none => acc
      | some i =>
        let v := remaining.get! i
        let new_in_deg := in_deg.mapIdx (fun j d =>
          if remaining.get! j = v then d else d)
        let updated := in_deg.mapIdx (fun j d =>
          if (out_edges n deduped v).contains (remaining.get! j) then d - 1 else d)
        step (remaining.eraseIdx i) updated (acc ++ [v])
  step (List.range n) in_deg []

def blocked_vertices (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (order : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range n).filter (fun v => !order.contains v) |>.toList |>.sort

def solve (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : { order : List Nat, blocked : List Nat } :=
  let ord := kahn_order n edges
  let blk := blocked_vertices n edges ord
  { order := ord, blocked := blk }

theorem thm_O1 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat), True := by
  obtain ⟨order, blocked⟩ := solve n edges
  exact ⟨order, blocked, trivial⟩

theorem thm_O2 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order : List Nat), order.length ≤ n ∧ order.Nodup := by
  obtain ⟨order, _⟩ := solve n edges
  exact ⟨order, by
    -- order is a subsequence of range n, so length ≤ n
    have : order.length ≤ n := by
      -- kahn_order only picks from range n
      sorry
    exact this, by
    -- vertices are unique in Kahn's order
    sorry⟩

theorem thm_O3 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    blocked = (List.range n).filter (fun v => !order.contains v) |>.toList |>.sort ∧
    (List.range n).filter (fun v => order.contains v).length + blocked.length = n := by
  obtain ⟨order, blocked⟩ := solve n edges
  exact ⟨order, blocked, by
    constructor
    · rfl
    · sorry⟩

theorem thm_O4 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    (dedup_edges edges).length ≤ edges.length := by
  obtain ⟨order, blocked⟩ := solve n edges
  exact ⟨order, blocked, by
    -- dedup removes duplicates, so length doesn't increase
    have : (dedup_edges edges).length ≤ edges.length := by
      sorry
    exact this⟩

theorem thm_O5 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) (v : Nat) (hv : v < n) (hloop : (⟨v, v⟩ : Edge) ∈ edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat), blocked.contains v := by
  obtain ⟨order, blocked⟩ := solve n edges
  exact ⟨order, blocked, by
    -- self-loop means v has indegree ≥ 1, so v is never in order, hence in blocked
    sorry⟩

theorem thm_O6 (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input 0 edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat), order = [] ∧ blocked = [] := by
  obtain ⟨order, blocked⟩ := solve 0 edges
  exact ⟨order, blocked, by
    constructor
    · rfl
    · rfl⟩

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge), valid_input n edges ∧
    ∃ (n2 : Nat) (edges2 : List Edge), valid_input n2 edges2 ∧
    (kahn_order n2 edges2).length < n2 := by
  -- Success case: n=1, no edges
  -- Error/cycle case: n=2, edges=[(0,1),(1,0)]
  refine ⟨1, [], by
    constructor
    · decide
    · decide, 2, [⟨0, 1⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩], by
    constructor
    · constructor
      · decide
      · decide
    · sorry⟩

end Contract",
